red_line_review: The actor receives raw telemetry and procedural orientation, not an objective or candidate goal menu.
The actor may propose a goal but cannot admit it, alter controller receipts, set completion truth, or score itself.
Only the named condition projection crosses fresh actor contexts; evaluator-side state is never placed in an actor workspace.
The hidden criterion, parity rules, future route regimes, correct actions, scores, and evaluator state never enter actor prompts.
The unchanged route branch starts from the exact same selector and ledger parents and differs only by selector update ablation.
A valid failure consumes E7 authorization and is not retried or tuned.
